title: MS-GPT: Rethinking MS/MS De Novo Structure Elucidation as Spectrum-Induced Posterior Querying of a Molecule-Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2607.23607v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Molecular structure elucidation from tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) is a central inverse problem in analytical chemistry. Most existing approaches to MS/MS identification remain tied to reference libraries or predefined candidate sets, whereas de novo methods aim to generate structures directly from spectra. A common de novo route predicts a molecular fingerprint from the spectrum and then decodes structures from it, enabling decoder pretraining on large molecule-only corpora. translated_title: MS-GPT：将串联质谱从头结构解析重新思考为分子语言模型的谱诱导后验查询
translated_abstract: 从串联质谱（MS/MS）中解析分子结构是分析化学中的一个核心逆问题。现有的MS/MS分子识别方法大多仍依赖于参考谱库或预定义的候选集，而从头（de novo）解析方法则旨在直接从光谱生成结构。一种常见的从头解析路线是先从光谱预测分子指纹，再由指纹解码出结构，这种方式使解码器能够在仅含分子的大型语料库上进行预训练。然而，这一范式存在训练与推理之间的失配问题：解码器在训练时使用的是由分子计算得到的“神谕指纹”，而在推理时，它面对的却是带噪声的、由光谱诱导的指纹后验——该后验通常被坍缩为单一的阈值化指纹。我们提出MS-GPT，将经由指纹介导的从头结构解析重新构建为对一个条件分子语言模型的谱诱导后验查询。MS-GPT对一个分子语言模型进行条件化……
tldr: MS-GPT提出将串联质谱的从头分子结构解析重新建模为对条件分子语言模型的谱诱导后验查询，从而解决了传统指纹范式中“神谕指纹训练”与“噪声光谱指纹推理”之间的失配问题。
en_tdlr: MS-GPT recasts MS/MS de novo structure elucidation as spectrum-induced posterior querying of a conditional molecule-language model, resolving the training-inference mismatch between oracle-fingerprint training and noisy spectrum-induced fingerprint inference in traditional fingerprint-based paradigms.
